name: Satwik Wats
bio: Satwik is currently a Master student at Universität zu Köln with a specialization in Condensed Matter and Quantum Technologies. His work at SM Lab focused on characterizing phase transitions with high precision in thick liquid crystal samples in the vicinity of Isotropic-Nematic transition point.
